node.title: Re^8: $VERSION in module files
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I take it you mean that they do something like a grep for '\$VERSION\s*=' and then execute that line/statement in isolation?

I just checked, [mod://App::cpanminus|cpanm] uses [mod://Parse::PMFile], its [https://metacpan.org/release/Parse-PMFile/source/lib/Parse/PMFile.pm#L177|_parse_version] is fairly complex*, and its code apparently borrows from [https://github.com/andk/pause/blob/a08490bec5/lib/PAUSE/pmfile.pm#L322|PAUSE::pmfile], the latter of course being the indexer for [https://pause.perl.org/|pause.perl.org]. Then there's [mod://Module::Info]'s [https://metacpan.org/release/Module-Info/source/lib/Module/Info.pm#L225|version], which borrows its code from [mod://ExtUtils::MM_Unix]... I suspect there's probably a couple more variations on this kind of code out there.

* Its comments also show some very interesting ways some modules set their versions: my $version = atan2(1,1) * 4; $Acme::Pi::VERSION = substr("$version", 0, 16); :-)
